fields.description:
Re-add Deposit Range as two numeric fields plus a display formula, and add Avg Deposit Target. Deposit and Redeposit are different things and Jumpr conflated them — this is the fix.

=== FIELDS ===

* Deposit Range Min — Number/Currency

* Deposit Range Max — Number/Currency

* Deposit Range (display) — Formula(Text), renders 'min-max' for quick view

* Avg Deposit Target — Number/Currency

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* Two separate numeric fields, not text. The range must be measurable against actual logged deposits — Joyce: 'we will want to see, based off of the deposits mean logged, where we're landing within that range.'

* Plus a formula field for display, same pattern as the Market short-code formula. Kobi: 'We can do the two separate fields for the actual configuration, and then I can have a formula field that converts that into something like this for quick view.' Joyce: 'Perfect. That's good.'

* Layout: under Commercial Terms, above Redeposit.

=== NOTES ===

* Fields may already exist — Taryn on Aug 17: 'I have the new fields in deals here, but when I go to here it's not reflecting.' She created new Deal fields; the blocker was surfacing them on the layout. Verify which of these four exist before assigning.

* Root cause worth recording: Kobi, Aug 11 — 'I thought the deposit and the redeposit was the same, at least based on the last PRD. I didn't see the deposit range anymore. So we'll add that back.' This is a Jumpr build gap, not a client change request — Deposit Range was in the client's original mockup and got dropped.

* Naming split so Target is clearly a single value and only Range is min/max. The original card title said 'deposit target/range with min and max values'.

=== SOURCE ===

* Aug 11 call — Joyce 30:39-32:24, 50:56

* Aug 17 call — new Deal fields created

Dependencies: None

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Polished 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.
